messages.content: You are an evidence-driven scientific replication judge. Compare claimed vs replicated numbers strictly. Cite specific numeric mismatches. Do not soften.

PAPER: Koneru et al. 2026 (OSTI 3363025), 'Hierarchical RL of a Short-Range Bond-Order Potential for Silica'. Introduces Q-Tersoff and ML-Tersoff, trained on 21 IZA polymorphs. Paper's alpha-quartz claims (Fig 4 heatmap, 300K, computed after equilibration in NVE per their Methods section):
  Q-Tersoff:  density_err ~0%, Si-O-Si err 1.7 deg, O-Si-O err 0.3 deg
  ML-Tersoff: density_err ~9.2%, Si-O-Si err 7.0 deg, O-Si-O err 0.4 deg
Exp targets: rho=2.648 g/cm^3, Si-O-Si=143.7 deg, O-Si-O=109.47 deg.

OUR REPLICATION on UICGPU (LAMMPS 29Aug2024) using their EXACT released potentials + released quartz.data seed (5x5x5, 1125 atoms):

1) VERBATIM in.relax (iso box/relax then NVE at 298K -> drifts to 1080K):
   Q-Tersoff  rho=1.735 (err 34.5%), ML-Tersoff rho=1.591 (err 39.9%). Not usable for angle comparison.

2) MINIMIZATION at 0K (aniso or tri box/relax to zero pressure, no MD):
   Q-Tersoff  rho=2.100 (err 20.7%), Si-O-Si=168.78+/-2.71 (err +25 deg), O-Si-O=111.79+/-29.3 (err 2.3 deg)
   ML-Tersoff rho=1.949 (err 26.4%), Si-O-Si=174.99+/-0.00 (err +31 deg), O-Si-O=111.80+/-29.7 (err 2.3 deg)
   Both potentials find a minimum-energy state that is NOT alpha-quartz — hexagonal cell dilates ~50% along c, contracts a,b.

3) NPT at 298K for 20 ps (which is closer to how the paper's Methods say properties are computed):
   Q-Tersoff  rho=2.029 (err 23.4%), Si-O-Si=147.55+/-27.5 (err +3.85 deg), O-Si-O=108.22+/-26.0 (err -1.25 deg), Si coord: 97.6% 4-fold
   ML-Tersoff rho=1.856 (err 29.9%), Si-O-Si=128.68+/-28.7 (err -15.02 deg), O-Si-O=105.95+/-35.3 (err -3.52 deg), Si coord: only 77% 4-fold (23% broken tetrahedra)

Interpretation:
- Density claim is CONTRADICTED across all protocols. Every protocol we tried gave 20-40% density deficit versus experimental 2.648; paper claims 0% for Q-Tersoff, 9.2% for ML-Tersoff.
- Angle claims are PARTIALLY testable: under NPT, Q-Tersoff's mean Si-O-Si is 3.85 deg above exp (paper claim 1.7 deg — same order of magnitude, our value 2.3x their reported error), and O-Si-O is 1.25 deg off (paper 0.3 deg — 4x their reported error). Under NPT, ML-Tersoff's Si-O-Si is 15 deg below exp (paper claim 7 deg above), i.e. wrong sign and 2x magnitude.
- ML-Tersoff coordination is CONTRADICTED: 23% of Si is NOT 4-coordinated at 298K NPT, invalidating the paper's implicit claim of tetrahedral network preservation.

RENDER A SINGLE-WORD VERDICT (REPLICATED / PARTIAL / SPOT-CHECK / CONTRADICTED / FAILED / BLOCKED) for the alpha-quartz-only subset that the released repo directly supports. Then justify in 6-10 lines with specific numbers. This is the alpha-quartz replication only; the full 21-polymorph benchmark requires additional structure files not shipped.
